intro.title: Faster Releases, Fewer Outages, Lower Cloud Bills
paragraphs: Many teams still deploy by hand, fear release days, discover outages from customers and watch cloud bills climb every month. DevOps fixes this by automating how software is built, tested, deployed and monitored, and by treating infrastructure as code that can be versioned, reviewed and repeated.

As a DevOps service provider, we help you at whatever stage you are. Our DevOps consulting services assess your current setup and build a practical roadmap. Our engineers then implement CI/CD pipelines, containerise applications, migrate workloads to the cloud, set up monitoring and security, and optimise costs. If you prefer, we run it all for you as managed DevOps, also known as DevOps as a service.

We work with startups, SaaS companies and enterprises across public, private, hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Building a new product? See our <saas>SaaS development</saas> services, or <contact>book a free DevOps assessment</contact>.

faqs.title: Cloud & DevOps FAQs
faqs.subtitle: Quick answers about DevOps services and cloud.

items.q: What is DevOps as a service?
items.a: DevOps as a service means an external team designs, runs and improves your CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, monitoring and security for a monthly fee, so you get senior DevOps expertise without hiring a full in-house team.

items.q: What do DevOps consulting services include?
items.a: They typically include an assessment of your current setup, a DevOps roadmap, CI/CD pipeline automation, infrastructure as code, containerisation, cloud migration, monitoring, security and training for your team.

items.q: Can you migrate our application to the cloud without downtime?
items.a: In most cases, yes. We plan migrations in phases, replicate data, test in parallel and switch traffic gradually, keeping downtime to zero or a few minutes in a planned window.

items.q: How can you reduce our cloud costs?
items.a: We right-size servers, remove unused resources, use reserved or spot capacity, add auto-scaling, optimise storage and data transfer, and set budgets and alerts. Many clients cut their cloud bill by 20 to 40 percent.

items.q: Do you work with hybrid and multi-cloud environments?
items.a: Yes. We work across major public clouds, private cloud and on-premise servers, and design hybrid or multi-cloud setups when they make sense for cost, compliance or resilience.

items.q: How much do DevOps services cost?
items.a: A DevOps assessment typically costs $1,500 to $4,000, implementation projects $4,000 to $20,000, and managed DevOps starts from around $1,000 per month, depending on your infrastructure and support needs.

items.q: Do you provide 24/7 monitoring and support?
items.a: Yes. Our managed DevOps plans include round-the-clock monitoring, alerting and incident response, with SLAs based on how critical your systems are.
